messages:
Maria (CS Lead): Quick draft of a compact pilot runbook to share with new customers. Goal: one-page actionable guidance for caching, batching, streaming, and renewal-risk signs. Pls skim and suggest edits.

Dan (Eng): Add a tiny client batching snippet and token-budget note. Keep defaults conservative.

Maria (CS Lead): Draft bullets for customers:
- One-page checklist (must do before go-live): 1) set token budget & expected SLA; 2) enable route cache (TTL=60s) for repeat prompts; 3) enable streaming for UI flows; 4) set client batch window=50ms or max 8 reqs.
- Warm pools: start 2 warm workers per 10 active tenants; add jittered start to avoid spikes.
- Server batch caps: prefer max 64 requests or 256 tokens per batch for latency-sensitive pilots.
- Cache key pattern: tenant_id|route|prompt_prefix (avoid full prompt to keep cache hit rate).
- Fallbacks: if latency spikes, route to smaller model or enable streaming partial results.

Teddy (SRE): Probe example for warm instances:
```
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /health
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3
```
Add note: use startup jitter 0-30s.

Dan (Eng): Client pseudo-code for SDK batching:
```js
// batcher pseudo
batcher.add(req)
setTimeout(() => batcher.flush(), 50)
if (batch.length >= 8) batcher.flush()
```
Also add token-budget guidance: for interactive UI, reserve 5k tokens/day per active seat as starting point and iterate from telemetry.

Olivia (PM): Can we map renewal-risk signals to actions? e.g.:
- Low usage: 7d MAU down >40% -> outreach + re-engagement playbook
- QoE issues: latency >2x for 3 days -> escalate to SRE + temporary model downgrade
- Errors/tickets: errors >1% with open ticket -> CS-managed remediation + credits discussion
Include mitigations: prefill, reduced model size, increase warm pool for high churn windows.

Maria (CS Lead): Good. I'll make a trimmed 1-pager for onboarding email and a longer internal checklist for CS reps. Ops-bot: please create canonical runbook link.

ops-bot: Note created: runbook/cs/pilot-ops-quickshare-v1 (internal) :page_facing_up:

Maria (CS Lead): Thanks — I'll upload the 1-pager by EOD and flag the internal doc for review. :thumbsup:
